summary: A 1933 CCC-built steel fire tower in Kisatchie National Forest, Grant Parish; taken out of service in 1982 and later removed by the Louisiana National Guard.

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor steel tower with an LS-40 cab
facts.status_note: The tower was removed; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Built by CCC Co. 1476 from Camp F-1 (register)
CCC crew manned the tower until the CCC was disbanded in 1942; US Forest Service personnel then operated it until 1982
Taken out of service for state overflights
Date registered February 24, 2011 as US 855, LA 2

evidence.supports: site in Kisatchie National Forest, Grant Parish
page is a Louisiana lookout history for Grant Parish
first tower on the first Southern National Forest, tied to 1929
evidence.quote: was the first tower to be constructed on the first Southern National Forest (Kisatchie 1929)

evidence.supports: built 1933 by CCC Co. 1476 from Camp F-1
evidence.quote: Built in 1933 by CCC Co. 1476 Camp F-1

evidence.supports: 100-foot Aermotor steel tower with LS-40 cab
evidence.quote: this 100' Aermotor 100' steel tower with LS-40

evidence.supports: CCC crew manned the tower until 1942
evidence.quote: was manned by this CCC unit until the disbanding of the CCC in 1942

evidence.supports: Forest Service operated the tower; taken out of service in 1982
evidence.quote: US Forest Service personnel took over operation of the tower until 1982 when it was taken out of service for State over-flights

evidence.supports: tower removed by the Louisiana National Guard for demolition practice

evidence.supports: first removal attempt knocked tower off its pilings; two attempts needed
evidence.quote: It took two attempts because the first attempt caused the tower to on pop off its foundational pilings but remained standing.

evidence.supports: register's only current view is a photo of the approach to the site

notes_for_editor: No source read gives the year the Louisiana National Guard removed the tower, so the story and events leave the removal undated. Search results did not settle it: the Wikipedia Louisiana list's 'Catahoula' entry is a parish heading for a different tower, and the 2011 Louisiana chapter report only records the site's registration. The record has no built event; the register gives 1933 and it is added here. The NGS datasheet itself was not read; the description comes via the Forest Lookouts page. No source describes access or remains at the site today.
